# Shapes and Angles

Geometry is the study of shapes, sizes and the space they take up.

<div class="teacher-note">This raw HTML block is not lesson text.</div>

### Right angles

A right angle measures exactly 90 degrees. The corner of a page is a good example.

## Triangles

A triangle has three sides and three angles. Its angles always add up to 180 degrees.

| Type        | Sides equal |
| ----------- | ----------- |
| Equilateral | 3           |
| Isosceles   | 2           |
| Scalene     | 0           |

## Quadrilaterals

A quadrilateral has four sides. Squares, rectangles and kites are all quadrilaterals.

![A square drawn on grid paper](square.png)

#

## Summary

Shapes are described by their sides and angles.
